name: Announcer
description: Controls fights heckles gladiators

name: Semyon
description: Former gladiator staked in arena. Joins Veiled Alliance after rescue. Joins party for one Arena fight.

name: Venyz
description: Second staked slave beyond help.

name: Scar
description: King of the Pens. Captured to please Tectuktitlay. Cautious escape plan via Arena west exit after 5 visits.

name: Merzol
description: Would-be King of the Pens. Less organized. Escape after 3 Arena visits. Riskier.

name: Trustee
description: Old gladiator. Former wilderness guide. Lets party see Dinos.

name: Dinos
description: Slave cook. Imprisoned for accidentally feeding bad food to a templar. Heals Gilal.

name: Mirlon
description: Vain gladiator bribed by Templar Pehtucl to betray escapees.

name: Gilal
description: Memory-damaged gladiator. Knows escape info. Healable by Dinos.

name: Templar Pehtucl
description: In charge of Slave Pens. Corrupt. Carries Bloodwrath sword +1.

name: Kurzak
description: Main guard. Takes bribes gives nothing. Lets Mirlon through.

name: Bonecrusher
description: Half-giant monster trainer. Retrieves laggard slaves.

name: Churrr
description: Beady-eyed controller of low warrens. Kidnapped chief's daughter for Mikquetzl.

name: High Warren Chief
description: Tari leader. Has Helm of Contemplation. Devastated by kidnapped daughter.

name: High Warren Chief's Daughter
description: Kidnapped plucky. Rushes into battle even when weakened.

name: Skull Guardians
description: Tari transformed by Dagolar. Protect the Elders. Can give bone crank.

name: Elders
description: Animated skulls of past tari leaders. Haughty. Grant Staff of Parting.

name: Mikquetzl
description: Disgraced templar. Insane. Rules tari worshippers. Has Chameleon Gloves.

name: Dagolar
description: 20th-level human psionicist. Conducts experiments. Creator of Dagolar slimes.

name: Keldar
description: Dagolar's warped servant. Keeps book of victims. Teleports unless killed in one shot.

name: Goburnix
description: Dagolar's brother turned zombie. Follows party if freed. Can expose Jake or Mow.

name: Old One-eye
description: NPC in fields region.

name: Egrus
description: Stays near camp unless party reads scroll on nearby body.

name: Chahl
description: Leader of Teaquetzl. Adopted daughter Katura.

name: Katura
description: Chahl's adopted daughter. Fascinated by magical items. Visits Elven Caravan.

name: The Visionary
description: Halfling found half-dead in desert. Prophecy of slave villages' destruction drives alliance.

name: Father Garyn
description: Cleric of water. Tends villagers' spiritual needs. Injured escaping slavery.

name: Village Council
description: Provides news on Drajian army. Asks party to gather allies.

name: Toonuu
description: Sells salt. Salt needed for mastyrial Alita from Demothi.

name: Krikor
description: Cedrilte villager.

name: Chaya
description: Speak first before being led to key location.

name: Kasha
description: Escaped slave. Gives warning.

name: Uzoma
description: Drajian guard patrol leader. Mistakes party for guards.

name: Wyrmias
description: Defiler controlling Gedron. Man of his word — duels if given both statue pieces.

name: Linara
description: 6th-level preserver unaffected by Wyrmias. Waiting to hear from her sister Jasmine.

name: Gedron Mayor
description: Wyrmias' puppet. Agrees to alliance after village freed.

name: Melkor
description: Travelling merchant stuck in village.

name: Jasmine
description: 9th-level human preserver. Came to retrieve statue piece for Wyrmias.

name: Arant
description: Holds captured gladiators from Gedron and Cedrilte. Has second statue piece.

name: Cragg
description: Former advisor turned greater shadow. Killed the king. Has Genie bottle.

name: King Dwyer
description: Spirit of former king. On the dais. Stepping on dais angers him.

name: The Genie
description: Grants three wishes. Critical late-game asset.

name: Psurlons
description: Guard the ruins. 30% magic resistant. Require +1 weapons.

name: Hermit Defiler
description: Found Lava Rift began summoning fire elementals.

name: Rift Ranger
description: Only survivor of band that drove off the lava hermit.

name: Notaku
description: Elven merchant. Magical herbs and spell components. Sends quests.

name: Sage/Wise Hermit
description: Wanders looking for Veiled Alliance. Identifies magic items. Gives wand and obelisk gem.

name: Demothi
description: Trains mastyrials. Selling Alita requires bag of salt from Toonuu.

name: Sand Druid
description: Watches over oasis. Ensures not defiled. Gives butterfly wings.

name: Slaver Templar
description: Has whistle to summon troops.

name: The Messenger
description: Carries notes between templar and noble. Can summon up to 4 blue slaad.

name: Hototo's Band
description: Slave transfer band. Can be manipulated with deception.

name: Dagger's Band
description: Slave transfer band. Can be manipulated with deception.

name: Nirveli
description: Noble slave gives thanks when freed.

name: Drisana
description: Caravan master. Wants raids stopped. Acts as judge in Tobrian dispute.

name: Larissa
description: Seer of minor abilities. Tells fortunes for ceramic pieces.

name: Kel
description: Mage merchant sells goods many non-magical.

name: Jark
description: Honest merchant. Armor weapons rumors.

name: Tobrian
description: Wine merchant and ex-slave merchant. Tries to poison party. Talisman of venom prevents.

name: Tidzio
description: Halfling wanderer. Information about Gemfields.

name: Ylakez
description: Refugee whose village was burned. Information about Tectuktitlay for money.

name: Ketzia
description: Refugee whose village was burned. Information about templars for money.

name: Hesutu
description: Dwarf who lost his focus when Drajian troops destroyed his tribe. Can be given new purpose.

name: Ssurran Shaman
description: 3rd-level cleric.

name: Balkazar
description: Receives terror extract from Notaku.

name: Kalinin
description: Warrior leader of prisoners. Gives sword Hornblade. Allies with Teaquetzl if rescued.

name: Kraxis
description: Drajian commander. Final battle antagonist.

name: Gareth (Selucus)
description: Half-giant gladiator. Tectuktitlay's favorite. Broke a templar's neck. Joins party.

name: Saria
description: Half-elf thief/preserver. Killed templar at auction. Joins party.

name: Tarim
description: Thri-kreen female hunter. Joins party.

name: Korval Dust
description: Ancient preserver. Former advisor to a Sorcerer-King. Arranged the party's circumstances partially.

name: Sela
description: Former defiler attempting impossible conversion to preserver.

name: The Voice
description: Psionic recording. Last transmission of pre-cataclysm civilization.

name: The Archivist
description: Last personality of Spire's builders preserved as psionic data. Has opinions.

name: Elder Pirdan
description: Alliance defiler faction leader. Genuinely grieving for Athas. Wrong about the method.
